messages: lina: Pushed updated compare table mocks to figma (frame: compare_v3). Notable changes: badges moved into a compact column, new pin affordance, and a persistent sort label in the toolbar. Thoughts? omar: Love the persistent sort label. One small UX ask: can we make the toolbar sticky when scrolling horizontally so the label doesn't disappear? kevin: Sticky toolbar might be tricky with our existing table component but doable. We should measure reflow impact. Also the compact badge column needs clear keyboard targets. We'll use aria-describedby for tooltip text. mika: On the badges themselves: prefer showing numeric tooltip for perf (e.g., "p50 12ms • p95 45ms"). Keep inline text minimal. kevin: Quick CSS example for collapsed badge icon with tooltip/focus: ``` ``` tess: Accessibility: orange badges still problematic at small sizes. Recommend swapping to a navy/amber combo for contrast. Also ensure the tooltip is accessible to screen readers (role=tooltip + aria-expanded pattern for interactive). lina: Regarding pin behavior — prototype pins per-user. Should pinned rows float to the top of the table or just mark visually? I think floating to top in current sort vs. keeping ordering stable might surprise users. omar: I vote visually marking only, with a filter option "Pinned" in the rail. Floating breaks sort semantics. mika: Agree: mark visually; add quick filter to show only pinned below the search box. Also add small count next to filter (like Pinned (3)). kevin: Implementation concern: making pinned rows sticky requires moving DOM nodes; if we only visually mark it and then filter, front-end is simpler. mika: Another micro-copy ask: change badge label from "Perf" to "Performance" in tooltip and aria labels. Keep column header short as "Perf" but aria-label="Performance column". tess: Keyboard flow checklist I'm drafting: 1) Tab into table -> focus first row pinch point 2) Arrow keys to navigate rows 3) Enter/space to open compare modal 4) 'p' to toggle pin when row focused (if no conflict). Also ensure screen reader announces pinned state when focused. omar: Analytics: capture click paths for pinned -> compare -> deploy to see if pin usage correlates with conversions. Add properties: origin (table/compare-modal), row_index, model_version. kevin: For mobile we should hide the badge column and show a chevron that expands a compact details panel (perf/cost) for each row. Avoid horizontal scroll on small devices. lina: I'll update mocks to show non-floating pin + pinned filter + tooltip copy changes. Will post new figma link when ready. mika: Action items: - kevin: prototype keyboard/aria patterns + mobile expand panel (ETA Thu) - tess: finalize color tokens + keyboard checklist + screen reader cues (ETA Wed) - omar: add analytics schema for pin flows (ETA Fri) - lina: update figma with non-floating pin + pinned filter (ETA Wed) design-bot: Design sync scheduled Wed 10:30am in #design-review :bell: mika: Thanks folks — will review the prototype once Kevin posts it.
